attributes.aspect: width/height of the box, e.g. 16/10; or size the element with CSS
attributes.state: the state to show (an id from `states`); changing it animates there
attributes.theme: light | dark | auto (default auto, following the reader)

css.--viz-bg: the frame's background (default transparent: the host's shows through)

events.viz:state: detail: {state, index} — after any state change, including the reader's

methods.setState(id, {instant}): animate (or jump) to a state; returns a promise that resolves when it is shown
methods.states: the states, as in this manifest, once ready

layout.note: Fills whatever box it is given; text inside is axes, labels and annotations only — headline, prose and captions belong to the host page.

sources.publisher: WHO/UNICEF Estimates of National Immunization Coverage, via Our World in Data
UN World Population Prospects, via Our World in Data
UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation, via Our World in Data

states.description: In 2000: each country raised by the share of its infants reached by the four newer vaccines (hepatitis B, Hib, pneumococcal, rotavirus). The story event carries each vaccine's worldwide coverage then and now.
states.title: Then

states.description: 2000 to 2025, played: the map rises as countries add the newer vaccines; the countries with the biggest gains are named.
states.title: Now

states.description: Each newer vaccine's worldwide coverage, 2000 to 2025, with the third DTP dose for reference; the map dims beneath.
states.title: Vaccines

states.description: Infants who did not get the third DTP dose in 2025, by country (births × the uncovered share); the most are named. The story event carries the total and the top five's share.
states.title: Gap

states.description: Under-five mortality, 2000 falling to the latest year; the biggest falls are named. The story event carries the world rate then and now.
states.title: Survival
